Name: Alternative Portraits and Sprites for Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)
Author: Chupalanuxus
Description:
[b][i][center]Alternative Portraits and Sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16220?tab=files]Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)[/url]﻿[/center][/i][/b]
These are some alternative Sprites that I modified and  'created' to modify the mod (a mix of Caroline's original face adapted to the Mod), and I thought I'd share it with anyone who might be interested.

Using it is easy, you just have to replace the original .png of the mod with these[i]
-Assets
-Sprites
-Portraits[/i]

Downloads.DisplayName: Alternative Portraits and Sprites for Childhood Sw
Downloads.FileName: Alternative Portraits and Sprites for Childhood Sw-30539-1-0-1735870392.zip
Downloads.Description: The textures are in their folders ("assets" - "Sprites" & "Portraits"). Just drag them to the Mod Folder "Childhood Sweetheart Caroline (Overhaul)" and "Write Into", then "OverWrite"
